mechanics.batchSize: Explicit nominal input count per recipe; never assume one universal batch size
mechanics.minimumSkill: minimumEligibleSkill and actualSkill preserved, unknown as null
mechanics.identity: TWW Retail milling input/output stable key, patch epoch and independent study family required
mechanics.completedCasts: Actual cast denominator, never netConsumed/nominalBatchSize when refunds possible
mechanics.coOutputs: Marginal outputs may co-occur; never force marginal probabilities to sum to one

identification.actualCasts: Exact sample E=totalOutputs/completedCasts; sample P=positiveCasts/completedCasts when both measured
identification.netAndSaved: Exact casts only if netConsumed+savedTotal is divisible by nominalBatchSize
identification.netOnly: Lower bound ceil(netConsumed/batchSize); upper bound unidentified without a per-cast saving cap
identification.verifiedOrScenarioCap: Upper bound floor(netConsumed/(batchSize-maxSavedPerCast)); status and provenance mandatory
identification.boundedE: [totalOutputs/maxCasts,totalOutputs/minCasts] for finite positive cast bounds; lower=0 if maxCasts unknown
identification.yieldBounds: Positive-cast observed min/max are descriptive sample ranges, never hard game limits
identification.inverse: conditionalMean=E/P for P>0; cannot infer P, min, max from E alone
identification.uncertainty: These are accounting identification bounds, NOT sampling confidence intervals or evidence of population rates

notRun: Native Node execution of exact committed source
evidenceResearcherRequest: For the twelve target mappings, collect zero-inclusive completed-cast logs with all outputs/ranks, input batch, net consumed, saved/refunded units, patch epoch, actual/minimum eligible skill, spec, gear and independent study-family ID. If only inventory deltas exist, obtain verified saving cap before bounding casts.
independentValidatorRequest: Native-run exact committed source; independently verify cast conservation, denominator interval sharpness, adversarial context arrays, scenario-cap status and economic isolation; require whole-family held-out observations for evidence promotion.
blockers: Current priority backlog supplies no new zero-inclusive cast study for this family
